items.body_html: because the runner mutates git, the action is claimed before it runs: a CAS commit takes action_pending → action_running(request_id) + ACTION_RUNNING; only the winner reaches the runner (a concurrent RUN_ACTION with a different op_id sees action_running ⇒ not_awaiting_action; the winner replayed is Duplicate). The trigger is version-checked (Stale) and op_id-idempotent (Duplicate) before the claim — like SUBMIT_DECISION / RESUME_WAIT. The same marker-first shape as LC2 release

items.name_html: the outcome selects, the kernel does not
items.body_html: an action routes to outcomes[outcome_key].target; the kernel knows no outcome meanings (de-vocabularized, like decisions). Targets resolve at load (validate_action_steps); an outcome not in the map (or infra_error) re-parks action_pending + audits the ACTION_RESULT — never a post-side-effect reject (the side effect already ran)

items.name_html: trigger validates payload; action examines the workspace
items.body_html: the RUN_ACTION trigger validates only the payload (required fields, e.g. the commit message) — missing ⇒ missing_required_field, no run. Workspace reality (nothing staged, conflict) is an action business_failure, surfaced as an outcome_key, never a trigger reject

a business_failure (or any outcome) whose target is the action step itself re-parks WAITING(action_pending) — the operator fixes the workspace (resolve conflict, stage files) and re-triggers; an infra_error with no declared route stays parked + audited (retry is L9)

items.name_html: the action result is recorded with evidence
items.body_html: every run appends an ACTION_RESULT (outcome + outputs + evidence_refs) before routing — the outcome inline in T1, logs in T3 (LC1 INV-3); a parked instance carries no agent dispatch (honest WAITING)

items.name_html: an outcome may emit a release boundary
items.body_html: an outcome’s emits adds a boundary event to the committed outcome; boundary_events_of carries it to LC2 (merged ⇒ merge_completed ⇒ worktree release). The action does not release — it only emits the boundary; LC2 owns the release

items.name_html: action is select, gate is filter
items.body_html: a type: action step produces the routing key; a gate (L2) only allow|warn|blocks a key an actor already chose. Same runner family, disjoint graph-roles — an action is never a gate and vice versa
